Application Data.NAME: Active Sports Equipment Co.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Active Sports Equipment Co. specializes in retailing a wide range of sporting goods, including fitness equipment, bicycles, camping gear, and outdoor apparel. Our store offers high-quality products for athletes and outdoor enthusiasts, with knowledgeable staff available to assist customers in finding the right equipment for their needs. We also provide services such as bike repairs and personalized product recommendations to enhance the shopping experience.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 02/15/2023, a customer slipped and fell in the store due to a wet floor, leading to a claim of $2,500. The claim is currently settled, and the status is closed.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, UL listed, burglary and fire resistant safe, rated for up to 1,000 lbs, equipped with a digital keypad lock.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security cameras and motion sensors installed, along with two on-site security personnel during peak hours.
